essay:
Money vs. No Money

I feel like kids should get money for doing chores. Because they would be able to earn moneyand have a budget at 7-1q or something.

So I fell like kids should get money for doing chores because they would be able to learn as a kid how to make money. Example. So, a kid doesnt do chores or earn money as a kid so when he / she grows up they would not know how to make money without begging thier parents.

It is also because they would have motivation. When I say this I mean normally kids don't do chores if they are not forced right? Well if we have money they would want to do the chores. Example. A kid doesn't want to do chores because it is boring. So, if you have money they ( kids ) would want to do the chores.

While I explained lots on this side let's move on to the other side. Somost people on the other side would say no. Because if we have this, kids will just wabt to do it a lot and  the parents will eventually go broke.

So I feel like kids should get money because they will know how to earn money as a kid and they will have motivation to do the chores. So my opinion is yes. Kids should get miney for doing chores.
